name: QuickCapture_Android
description: QuickCapture Android SDK from Extrieve: document scanning for native Android apps with auto-crop, DPI control and compression to JPEG, PDF and TIFF

paragraphs: QuickCapture for Android (v4.2) is Extrieve's document scanning, imaging and security SDK for native Android apps written in Java or Kotlin. It captures documents with the device camera, detects edges and corrects the document angle with Extrieve's KIMORA AI v3 document detection, then crops, optimises and compresses the image and outputs JPEG, PDF or TIFF.
Product page · Documentation · All platforms · Android demo app · Discussions · Contact
features: Built for documents: capture tuned for document quality, strong compression and image optimisation, with the readability of the output kept in mind.
Output control: set the DPI, page layout and size of output images, and convert them to PDF and TIFF.
Automatic orientation: detects and corrects the orientation and rotation of captured documents.
QR code and barcode: scanning and generation.
Signature and face capture: dedicated capture activities for signatures and face photos, plus face detection and matching.
